move: prompt types and sends, dots think, reply streams word by word
how: A dark chat window with a compose bar. A caret blinks (steps ease, infinite). From 4% TextPlugin types the first prompt over 1.4s, the send button presses, the input clears and the user bubble slides up (y 18 to 0, power3.out); the assistant row appears with three dots bouncing y -5 in a stagger (4 half-beats) and at 35% the dots hide and the reply streams in word by word (opacity 0 to 1, y 6 to 0, 0.055s stagger, power2.out). The second exchange repeats from 54% with a shorter prompt and a 0.07s word stagger. At 94% all messages lift 16px and fade with a 0.06s stagger and set() calls at the last frame restore the hidden state.
adapt: Replace the assistant name, the two prompts and the two replies (the word spans are generated from the strings), the avatar gradient and accent purple; keep the 0.055s word stagger and the dots beat, which is what makes the streaming feel live.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the window from shot.exchanges and splits replies into .w spans; animate returns the timeline with exchange one at 0.03-0.5D and two at 0.54-0.85D, clear at 0.94D. The infinite caret tween should become a finite repeat sized to D; scope querySelector calls to el and register TextPlugin.
caveats: caret tween uses repeat:-1, an infinite child; replace with repeat: Math.ceil(D/0.8) so tl.duration() stays finite
display toggles on the dots via set() rely on GSAP reverting when scrubbed backwards
